reason: The report restricts to the north region (N=633) with no stated justification and concludes 'no effect' from an insignificant, underpowered estimate (SE 0.40). On all 2000 firms, with the same pre-period controls, training_hours has a positive and significant coefficient (about 0.58, p≈0.012), and the result stays about the same with the full set of pre-period controls. A non-significant subsample result is not evidence of no effect.
